breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still explicitly uses the polar moment J = π d^4/32 in the Euler buckling calculation, repeating the original error. The ground truth requires using the second moment of area I = π d^4/64 for Euler buckling. The spec even computes J = 79,507.5 mm^4 (which is the polar moment value, double the correct I = 39,760.8 mm^4), confirming the error persists.
